description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewRelationship' class which manages the display and handling of relationship views within the SuiteCRM Module Builder interface. It includes methods for overriding relationship definitions from POST requests, rendering the relationship interface, and managing relationship parameters such as modules involved, relationship types, labels, and subpanels.

classes.name: ViewRelationship
classes.description: Manages the display and processing of module relationship configurations in SuiteCRM's Module Builder interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including the module name and title.

methods.name: overrideDefinitionFromPOST
methods.description: Overrides relationship definition parameters using data from POST requests, skipping certain keys based on request context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the relationship creation/edit view, handling module and relationship parameters, labels, relationship types, subpanels, and frontend template rendering.
